Thank you for using MD Reader.

MD Reader (the “App”) is developed and operated by 刘什么 (“we”, “us”). This Privacy Policy explains how information related to the App is handled. By using the App, you acknowledge this Policy.

1. Information We Process
The App is primarily local and usually does not require sign-in. Depending on use, this may include:
1.1 Local reading data: imported books, progress, bookmarks, highlights, notes, and reading stats, stored on your device by default.
1.2 Profile display data: nickname, bio, and avatar you set locally for in-app display.
1.3 Preferences: theme, language, font, spacing, page-turn mode, and similar settings stored locally.
1.4 Cache: temporary files such as cached network images; you can clear cache in the App.
1.5 Network-related data: when you use online features (URL import, remote images, external links, certain diagrams), standard technical data may be processed by the relevant network providers.

2. How We Use Information
To provide and improve reading features, remember settings and progress, and fulfill actions you request (e.g., clear cache, export notes). We do not sell your personal information or use local reading data for advertising profiles.

3. Storage
Core library and profile data remain on your device by default. We do not require uploading your shelf, notes, or profile to our own servers. Third-party pages or resources you open may be processed under their own rules and locations.

4. Sharing
We do not sell personal information. We may share or disclose information only with your consent, to comply with law, to protect legitimate rights as permitted by law, or as necessary when you use third-party links/resources.

5. Permissions
5.1 Internet: URL import, remote images, links, and some diagram rendering.
5.2 File access: when you choose files via the system picker, share sheet, or “Open with”.
You can manage permissions in system settings.

6. Third Parties
Open-source components and WebView content follow their own policies. We do not control third-party practices.

7. Children
If you are a minor, use the App with guardian guidance. Guardians may contact us regarding a minor’s information.

8. Your Choices
You may edit local profile data, delete books/notes/highlights, clear cache, or uninstall the App and clear app data.

9. Updates
We may update this Policy and will revise the “Last updated” date in the App. Significant changes will be highlighted more prominently.

10. Contact
